era: Game Boy / Nintendo 64 / GameCube / Nintendo Classics
summary: Nintendo's personal-watercraft racing series; preserve the Game Boy original separately, use Nintendo Classics for Wave Race 64, and GameCube/Dolphin for Blue Storm.

emulation.notes: Use link-cable-capable emulation for multiplayer testing.

primary.why: The original Wave Race is a Game Boy-only top-down racing game and has no sourced modern re-release route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Game Boy hardware or a Game Boy emulator with link-cable support if you want multiplayer preservation.

emulation.emulator: Nintendo Classics N64 app / local N64 emulator fallback
emulation.notes: Use official Nintendo Classics route first.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Official Nintendo Classics emulation or high-resolution local N64 emulation

primary.why: Wave Race 64 was re-released on Wii, Wii U, and Nintendo Classics; the current Nintendo Classics version is the best official modern route.
primary.how_to_play: Play through Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack's Nintendo 64 app; use original N64/iQue hardware or local N64 emulation only for comparison.

emulation.notes: Use Dolphin for higher output resolution or original GameCube hardware for native behavior.

primary.why: Blue Storm is a GameCube-only sequel and one of the GameCube's launch-era racing showcases, with weather and wave physics central to the design.
primary.how_to_play: Play on GameCube hardware or Dolphin with internal-resolution scaling; use original controls for the intended analog feel.
